# Implementation Plan: Dark/Light Theme Switching

**Branch**: `003-theme-switching` | **Date**: 2026-07-18 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/003-theme-switching/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit.plan` command. See `.specify/templates/plan-template.md` for the execution workflow.

## Summary

Implement a comprehensive dark/light theme system for the subhojit.build portfolio site using jaspr_content's built-in ContentTheme and ThemeToggle components. The system provides user-controlled theme switching with persistent preference storage, automatic system preference detection, smooth visual transitions, and WCAG AA compliant contrast ratios in both themes. All 16 components will be refactored to consume theme values from CSS custom properties generated by ContentTheme, enabling instant theme switching without component code changes.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Dart 3.10.0, Jaspr framework 0.23.1

**Primary Dependencies**:
- `jaspr: ^0.23.1` — Core web framework with CSS-in-Dart
- `jaspr_content: ^0.5.3+1` — ContentTheme, ThemeColor, ThemeToggle
- `jaspr_router: ^0.8.2` — SPA routing (already integrated)
- `jaspr_riverpod: ^0.4.6` — State management (not used for theme)

**Storage**: 
- **Client-side**: `localStorage` (Web Storage API) for theme preference persistence
- **Key**: `'jaspr:theme'`, values: `'light'` | `'dark'`
- **Fallback**: In-memory state if localStorage blocked (privacy mode)

**Testing**: 
- `jaspr_test: ^0.23.2` — Component testing framework
- Manual visual testing for both light and dark themes
- Lighthouse accessibility audit for contrast validation (target: 100 score)

**Target Platform**: 
- **Web**: Modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- **Build mode**: Static site generation (`jaspr: mode: static`)
- **Pre-rendering**: Server-side rendering (SSR) with client-side hydration
- **No IE11 support** (CSS custom properties required)

**Project Type**: Static website / portfolio site (Jaspr SSG)

**Performance Goals**:
- **Theme toggle response**: <100ms perceived delay (spec SC-002)
- **Build time impact**: <100ms added to `jaspr build`
- **Bundle size**: <5 KB gzipped for theme CSS (spec SC-007)
- **No layout shift**: Theme change affects colors only (no CLS)

**Constraints**:
- **WCAG AA contrast**: All text/background pairs must meet 4.5:1 (normal) or 3:1 (large) (spec FR-010)
- **No FOUC**: Theme must be applied before first paint (ThemeToggle SSR script requirement)
- **Accessibility**: Support `prefers-reduced-motion` for instant transitions (spec FR-009)
- **Backward compatibility**: Existing component API unchanged (import theme constants as before)

**Scale/Scope**:
- **16 files to refactor**: 9 components, 5 pages, 1 app shell, 1 theme file
- **19 color tokens**: All Lumina design system colors defined in ContentTheme
- **2 themes**: Light (default) and dark modes
- **Zero new packages**: All required dependencies already in pubspec.yaml

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

**Status**: ✅ NO VIOLATIONS

**Analysis**:

The constitution file is a template without specific project principles defined yet. No gates can be evaluated against placeholder content. Assuming standard web development best practices:

**Assumed Gates** (based on typical portfolio site principles):

1. **Accessibility First** (assumed gate)
   - **Status**: ✅ PASS
   - **Rationale**: Feature spec explicitly requires WCAG AA compliance (FR-010), keyboard navigation (FR-008), and reduced motion support (FR-009)

2. **Performance Budget** (assumed gate)
   - **Status**: ✅ PASS
   - **Rationale**: Spec defines success criteria for bundle size (<5 KB gzipped, SC-007) and response time (<100ms, SC-002)

3. **Progressive Enhancement** (assumed gate)
   - **Status**: ✅ PASS
   - **Rationale**: Theme system degrades gracefully — localStorage fallback to session-only, SSR pre-renders light theme for non-JS users

4. **No Breaking Changes** (assumed gate)
   - **Status**: ✅ PASS
   - **Rationale**: Existing component API unchanged (theme constants remain same names, just change implementation from `Color('#hex')` to `Color.variable('--name')`)

**Re-evaluation after Phase 1**: No constitution violations introduced. Design is backward-compatible and follows web accessibility standards.

## Complexity Tracking

> **Not applicable — no constitution violations to justify**

**Status**: ✅ NO VIOLATIONS

This feature introduces no architectural complexity requiring justification:
- Uses built-in jaspr_content theming system (industry standard pattern)
- No new state management layer (ContentTheme is declarative, ThemeToggle manages own state)
- No additional projects/services (single static web app)
- No new external dependencies (jaspr_content already in pubspec from 002-content-setup)
- Refactoring approach is atomic (all components in one pass), not incremental, minimizing coordination complexity
